stem: For A(−5) and B(7), point D divides segment AB externally in the ratio 2:5. Mark D on the number line.
solution: External division with m=2, n=5: $x=\frac{n a-m b}{n-m}$; D lies outside AB.

hints.text: For an external ratio the formula has a minus in the numerator and in the denominator.
D lies outside segment AB, on the side of the smaller ratio part. Mark one point.
Take care with the signs when subtracting m·b from n·a.
